{{DISPLAYTITLE:Antlion (''Tactics Advance'')}}
[[File:FFTA-Antlion.jpg|200px|right]]
[[File:FFTA-spr-Antlion.gif|left]]
{{Quote|Giant bug with needle-like legs and a powerful jaw.|Description}}
The '''Antlion''' is a blue insect in ''[[Final Fantasy Tactics Advance]]'', and unlike some previous games, a common enemy rather a [[boss]]. It makes use of its strong mandibles and affinity with sand to damage party members. It has a stronger relative called [[Jawbreaker]]s.

Its LVL 3 Def-Less is learnable as a [[Blue Magic (Tactics Advance)|Blue Magic]] ability; the [[Blue Mage (Tactics Advance)|Blue Mage]] needs to be on a [[level]] that is a multiple of 3 to learn it. Since the maximum level is 50, LVL 3 Def-Less can become [[Permanently missable content|missable]] after a unit passes level 48. LVL 3 Def-Less can be useful when an enemy's level is just right, since it always works and it has an area effect.

The Antlion's other ability, Sandstorm, is usable by [[Morpher]]s since they are capturable. Morphers can use Antlion abilities with Jawbreaker abilities if the player has one. Sandstorm provides damage while also blinding enemies, severely decreasing the accuracy on all of their attacks. Sandstorm's damage output can always be increased by feeding the monster.
